what_it_does: IoT devices and smart-home gadgets often run on batteries but need to charge from 110/220V household power. Existing converters are either bulky (inductive switching supplies), inefficient (linear regulators), or unreliable (switched-capacitor circuits that don't regulate voltage). This chip converts wall power (85–230V AC) to battery voltage (3.3–4.6V DC) with 81% peak efficiency using a sigma-floating switched-capacitor design—capacitors in series block the high voltage, and a smart three-mode active rectifier (a circuit that switches direction) minimizes wasted power during inactive phases. The approach is small, inexpensive, and doesn't need inductors.
